en.headline: Hong Kong and Vietnam sign memorandum on international dispute resolution
en.dek: Secretary for Justice Paul Lam and Vietnam’s Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs Le Anh Tuan signed the pact on Wednesday to strengthen capacity-building on economic, commercial and investment disputes.
body: The Department of Justice of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government signed a Memorandum of Co-operation with Vietnam’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Wednesday to enhance co-operation on building capacity for the prevention and settlement of international disputes.

The memorandum was signed by Secretary for Justice Paul Lam and Vietnam’s Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs Le Anh Tuan. It provides a framework for collaboration on capacity-building for legal officers in the economic, commercial and investment fields.

The Department of Justice said the signing will further consolidate Hong Kong’s status as a centre for international legal and dispute resolution services and strengthen its capacity in international law. It added that it will continue to pursue similar arrangements with other jurisdictions and international organisations.

zh.headline: 港越簽署合作備忘錄 加強國際爭議解決能力建設
zh.dek: 律政司司長林定國與越南外交部副部長黎英俊周三簽署備忘錄，框架涵蓋經濟、商業及投資領域的法律人員能力建設。
body: 香港特區政府律政司周三與越南外交部簽署合作備忘錄，加強兩地在避免及解決國際爭議方面的能力建設合作。
備忘錄由律政司司長林定國資深大律師與越南外交部副部長黎英俊共同簽署。協議提供框架，促進港越在經濟、商業及投資領域國際爭議的法律人員能力建設上的溝通與協作。
律政司表示，簽署將進一步巩固香港作為國際法律及爭議解決服務中心的地位，並加強其國際法能力建設。署方將繼續與其他司法管轄區及國際組織碰商類似安排。
